<?php
function produce222($saved,$marker) { echo "PRODUCER;"; return $saved; }
function shift222() { $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New222; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old222 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New222 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic222 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old222)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old222; $owner=new Magic222; $result=$owner->MiSsInG((\Closure::fromCallable("produce222"))($argument,shift222())); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";

<?php
function zero222() { $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "ZERO;"; return 7; }
class MagicZero222 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { echo ($arguments[0]===false && $arguments[1]===7)?"HANDLER;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner=new MagicZero222; $result=$owner->MiSsInG(false,(\Closure::fromCallable("zero222"))()); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
